rationale: Reproduction question for the verify question's witness. Receipt 01617c5662f34c3eb21857602f6cac4f is the only evidence that an isolated, stalled leader can return VerifyLeader success while a successor already leads at a higher term: six trials all showed the overlap, and three of them returned success while the other three answered leadership loss. That is a single execution of a per-trial choice, and it is the strongest safety-relevant claim in this run, so this update re-executes the fixed experiment 29a71a7377a44fdbac949d4808f7b847-experiment unchanged and in a clean copy. The retest asks whether the overlap still appears in every trial and whether the success-to-leadership-loss split is of the same order under the same stall, partition, reconnection delays and timeouts. Nothing is claimed until the new receipt exists; the current account stands as recorded.
